falsifier: This first material trial is the no-control core. Reject it and prohibit every risk overlay if base net return is not >0, base Sharpe is <0.75, doubled net return is not >0, doubled Sharpe is <0.35, fewer than four of six folds are positive, bull/bear/chop return or long-bull/short-bear/combined-chop attribution is not >0, a sleeve misses its 0.01 exposure, 0.10 active-bar, 0.01 mean-exposure, or 1000 USDT notional floor, any team-declared A5 score gate fails, or any other numeric gate in qualification_thresholds.json fails. Failure requires a separately preregistered mechanism pivot or DNF and cannot be rescued by controls.
thesis: Without risk-overlay assistance, a balanced adaptive mixture of causal crypto residual continuation and reversal can produce active, positive visible-development evidence across bull, bear, and chop after realistic and doubled costs.
